product: Diversified biopharma: oncology (IMDELLTRA tarlatamab, BLINCYTO, Vectibix, LUMAKRAS, Nplate, KYPROLIS), inflammation (TEZSPIRE, Otezla, Enbrel), general medicine (Repatha, EVENITY, Prolia), rare disease (TEPEZZA, KRYSTEXXA, UPLIZNA, TAVNEOS) and biosimilars (PAVBLU, AMJEVITA, WEZLANA). Obesity candidate MariTide is in multiple Phase 3 studies; dazodalibep is Phase 3 in Sjogren's disease.
demand: Volume-led and healthy. Q2 2026 total revenues rose 10% to $10.1B and product sales 9%, with twenty-two products at double-digit growth and seventeen annualizing above $1B. Six key growth drivers rose 26% and generated nearly 70% of quarterly product sales, per CEO Robert Bradway on 2026-08-04.
pricing_power: Mixed and weak on the legacy base. Net selling price fell for Prolia (-12%), XGEVA (-8%), Enbrel (-22%), Otezla (-9%) and MVASI (-16%), partly from IRA Medicare Part D price setting and higher 340B mix, while KRYSTEXXA (+23%) and TEPEZZA (+6%) showed positive price. Consolidated payer and PBM consolidation keeps pressure on discounts and rebates.
competition: Intense and multipolar. Obesity pits MariTide against Lilly and Novo Nordisk. Immunology faces biosimilars and new oral entrants on Otezla and Enbrel. EoE adds TEZSPIRE against Dupixent and Takeda. In ES-SCLC IMDELLTRA competes with other second-line and checkpoint regimens. Sjogren's disease currently has no approved competitor, so dazodalibep is first in class.
team: Chairman and CEO Robert A. Bradway. Jay Bradner, MD, is executive vice president of Research and Development, Artificial Intelligence and Data. CFO Peter Griffith retirement announced 2026-05-19 (8-K item 5.02). Chief Technology Officer David M. Reese retirement announced 2026-04-22 (8-K item 5.02).
market_strategy: Grow the six key drivers, expand labels and indications (Repatha cardiovascular, IMDELLTRA first line, dazodalibep, UPLIZNA, TEPEZZA), advance MariTide through Phase 3 into obesity, pursue bolt-on deals (Dark Blue Therapeutics acquired 2026-01-06), invest nearly $2B in US manufacturing, and return cash via a $2.52 quarterly dividend and buybacks up to $3.0B.
bull: Q2 2026 revenue $10.1B +10% with six growth drivers +26% and 70% of product sales; dated wins: OASIZ 301 (2026-09-22), DeLLphi-305 OS (2026-09-08), TEZSPIRE CROSSING (2026-08-27), Repatha mortality -20% (2026-08-31).
bear: Net price erodes legacy base: Prolia -12%, Enbrel -22%, Otezla -9%, IRA Part D from 2026-01-01; Q2 non-GAAP EPS +4% only, margin -0.5pt; cyber 8-K 2026-07-31 exfiltrated PHI; consensus Hold, mean target $383.46 below price.
falsifier: Q3 2026 results (expected 2026-11-04) showing product sales growth below 9% or non-GAAP EPS below $22.30 guidance floor would prove the growth-driver offset is failing.
web_what_changed: Q2 2026 results 2026-08-04 (revenue $10.1B +10%, six growth drivers +26%); Dazodalibep Phase 3 OASIZ 301 win 2026-09-22; IMDELLTRA plus Imfinzi DeLLphi-305 overall-survival win 2026-09-08; FDA cut IMDELLTRA monitoring to 6-8h 2026-09-14; TEZSPIRE Phase 3 CROSSING win in EoE 2026-08-27; Repatha mortality cut 20% 2026-08-31; CHMP positive opinion 2026-07-29; material-cyber-incident 8-K 2026-07-31; AMG 513 discontinued.
web_not_known_yesterday: No new company disclosure dated 2026-09-24 or 2026-09-25; latest primary release remains the 2026-09-22 OASIZ 301 topline. What was newly known on 2026-09-24 is market digestion of that data (reports of a 7.9% move) and a 2026-09-23 Jefferies price-target raise to $410. No dated IR event was added.
web_demand_price_volume_mix: Demand and volume, not price. Q2 2026 product sales +9% on volume (US volume +9%, ROW +8%); Repatha +37%, EVENITY +38%, UPLIZNA +90%, TEZSPIRE +42%, IMDELLTRA +115%, all volume-led. Price is a drag: Prolia net price -12%, XGEVA -8%, Enbrel -22%, Otezla -9%, MVASI -16%. Positive price only KRYSTEXXA +23% and TEPEZZA +6%. Mix shifts toward biosimilars (PAVBLU +121%).
web_suppliers: Amgen manufactures many products internally but relies on third-party contract manufacturers. The Horizon deal added 30-plus CMOs, many single-source, including the CMO producing TEPEZZA drug substance and the CMO producing all KRYSTEXXA drug substance in Israel, exposed to Middle East conflict. Cost of sales rose on higher profit-share and manufacturing costs, so the chain is constrained and concentrated.
web_customers: Sales run through a concentrated wholesaler-distributor base (Amgen references concentration of sales at certain wholesaler distributors in its 10-K risk factors); no single customer percentage is disclosed. Payer side is highly consolidated - CVS, Express Scripts and UnitedHealth Group among top plans and PBMs with rebate management organizations - which raises their leverage and caps net price.
web_who_loses: Biosimilar and generic makers gain as Amgen legacy brands erode (Prolia, XGEVA, Enbrel, Otezla). Obesity players Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk lose share if MariTide Phase 3 succeeds. In eosinophilic esophagitis, Sanofi-Regeneron Dupixent and Takeda face a new entrant. In small cell lung cancer, second-line and competing checkpoint regimens lose positioning. Novartis lipid franchise is pressured by Repatha outcomes data.
web_contradicting_evidence: Q2 non-GAAP EPS only +4% to $6.29 and non-GAAP operating margin fell 0.5pt to 48.4%; cost of sales rose. Material cybersecurity incident 8-K 2026-07-31: proprietary data, patient PHI and other information exfiltrated from third-party cloud. Legacy erosion: Prolia -32%, XGEVA -34%, Otezla -21%, Enbrel -4% with IRA Part D price setting from 2026-01-01. Consensus rating is Hold; mean target $383.46 sits below the ~$406 close. Baird and BofA carry UNDERPERFORM ratings. AMG 513 discontinued.
web_if_management_right: Six growth drivers (+26% y/y, about 70% of Q2 product sales) keep compounding; 2026 guidance revenue $38.2-39.4B and non-GAAP EPS $22.30-23.50 holds. Repatha mortality data broadens label and use; IMDELLTRA moves into first-line ES-SCLC maintenance; dazodalibep becomes a first-in-class therapy where no drug is approved; MariTide Phase 3 readouts (MARITIME-1/2) open a large obesity market.
web_if_management_wrong: Net-price erosion breaks first: more biosimilars on Prolia, XGEVA, Enbrel and Otezla plus IRA Medicare price setting compress the base faster than new products offset. Second, the cannabis - actually second, rising R&D on MariTide and launch costs keep non-GAAP margin and EPS flat. Third, cybersecurity-incident legal, notification and remediation costs plus $57.3B debt and only $3.5B quarterly free cash flow constrain buybacks.
web_second_order_beneficiaries: AstraZeneca is co-development partner on IMDELLTRA-durvalumab and TEZSPIRE. Single-source contract manufacturers, notably the Israel CMO for KRYSTEXXA drug substance and the TEPEZZA drug-substance CMO, get more volume. Veeva benefits from the global Vault CRM rollout. BeOne Medicines is about 17% owned by Amgen. Drug-delivery device and biologics-capacity suppliers gain from the near-$2B US manufacturing buildout.
